notesHint: State the conclusion and one audience action. Leave the final frame up long enough to act or scan.
description_en: The conclusion and one requested action dominate the final hold; a QR and restart link remain optional secondary affordances.
description_ko: 발표의 결론과 한 가지 행동 요청을 가장 크게 남기고, QR·URL·다시 보기는 필요한 경우에만 보조로 둡니다.
responsive: Keep conclusion and action text first; stack an optional QR/URL below on mobile with a reachable restart control.
reducedMotion: Show conclusion, action detail, optional URL/QR, and restart control immediately without typing or drawing.
purpose: 결론과 다음 행동을 기억하게 하고 선택적으로 후속 자료에 연결한다.

exampleCopy.title: 다음 점심 한 가지를 바꿔보기
lines: 가장 남기기 쉬운 메뉴와 바꿀 배식 선택지를 적어보기

sceneContract.fit: A conclusion that states one specific next action for the audience; QR is an optional follow-up resource.
sceneContract.unfit: Thank-you-only endings, multiple competing asks, or an invented/unclear QR destination.
sceneContract.requiredInputs: copy.title contains the conclusion or action; copy.lines contains the action detail. Optional deck.links.site and matching SVG in assets.images[0].
sceneContract.scrollBeatSemantics: The conclusion arrives first, action detail follows, then optional QR/URL assembles into its secondary place.
sceneContract.stableHold: By .48 the title, detail, optional URL/QR, and restart control are all visible and stay still.
sceneContract.projectorTypeCriteria: Conclusion has the largest type. QR remains secondary and URL is large enough to read.
sceneContract.labelCriteria: Never use copy.lines as a URL. The destination comes from deck.links.site; only pair a QR with that destination.
sceneContract.mobile: Claim and action appear first. Optional QR/URL and the restart link remain visible and reachable below.
sceneContract.reducedMotion: No character cascade, typing, or QR drawing; all supplied text and actions are immediately visible.
sceneContract.exampleContent: A concise recommendation, one concrete next step, optional source or registration URL.
sceneContract.unsupportedReason: A QR cannot substitute for a missing conclusion or a clear reason to take action.
sceneContract.nextImplementation: The URL is supplied from deck.links.site and QR is generated from that same URL. Review the .55/mobile/reduced hold when adapting content.
sceneContract.failureFallback: 구체적 청중 행동이 없으면 QR을 제거하고 발표 결론과 다음 질문을 한 문장으로 닫는다.
sceneContract.reviewNote: 선택 후보입니다. 대표 장면의 1440×900·1920×1080·390px·모션 감소 상태와 스크롤 역방향을 독립 검수하기 전에는 완성 템플릿으로 간주하지 않습니다.
